title: iPhone free for 10 min while 1 job waits

messages.text:
The iPhone has had no holder for 10 min (since 02:39Z; released by fix-hero-exit-threaded). The limit is 5 min.
Waiting on the status board: ops (owner mgmt-ops-10; its next step names the phone (unmarked)).
What unblocks it: the next of mgmt-ops-10 takes it (node tools/lock.mjs acquire iphone --owner <you> ...).
No steward on duty (mgmt-devices is parked): the lead handles this thread (I-175).
One message per idle period; this thread closes by itself when the slot is taken (tools/idle.mjs, I-105).

False alarm: no agent is waiting for the iPhone. Only your swipe test (T-175) needs it, and it starts when you say "ready".
- Cause: ops' board row still listed "read the menu fix's phone result (P-124)" as a next step. That read is already done and landed (8cbb54d4), but the word "phone" made the watcher count it as phone work.
- Fixed: I removed the stale step from ops' row, so the alarm clears.
What you need to do: nothing.
